reasons.correctness: PUT /{categoryId}/order returns 204 and requires ADMIN. reorderCategory checks size and set equality, so duplicates and foreign ids throw faq_reorder_mismatch. It sets displayOrder i+1 and saves. Unknown category reuses getFaqsByCategory's not-found. Acceptance 6/6.
reasons.convention_fit: The endpoint has @PreAuthorize and @RateLimit. Input is FaqReorderDtoIn. The new BusinessRuleTranslatableException key is in both messages_en and messages_pl. FaqService is injected through the explicit constructor. A new MockitoExtension unit test was added and run.
reasons.design_fit: Reuses getFaqsByCategory for the lookup and not-found path, and BaseService.save. Logic stays in the service. Method-level @RateLimit repeats the class-level one. FaqService is added to FaqCategoryController, but the path is category-scoped, which is acceptable.
reasons.test_quality: FaqServiceUnitTest covers the reorder, a missing id, a duplicate id, a foreign id and an unknown category, and asserts messageKey. It uses lenient strictness, never verifies save is skipped on rejection, and has no null-list case.
reasons.graph_use: An early graph query found the faq files. A dependents query on FaqService checked for constructor callers before editing. Later navigation used grep and reads, and a controller-dependents query ran after the edits.
